game: NYJ @ DET, Week 3 2026 (morning of kickoff; spread/total/weather/kick time not in pack)

script.base: No spread or total is saved, so this is a form script only. Detroit has been the higher-volume offense (Jahmyr Gibbs 45 car/208 rush yds and 13 targets; Amon-Ra St. Brown 27 tgt/209 yds; Sam LaPorta 15 tgt/100 yds) while the Jets have given Breece Hall the ball (38 car/131) and split the pass game (Adonai Mitchell 15 tgt/237 air, Garrett Wilson 14 tgt/136 yds). Detroit blitzes 42% and Geno Smith's EPA/dropback is 0.18 vs blitz and 0.18 vs no blitz, so pressure should create checkdowns to Hall and the tight ends rather than a collapse. Base case: a competitive, Detroit-leaning game with a real run lean (Gibbs and Hall) and live short/middle throws; Minkah Fitzpatrick out keeps a downfield path if the Jets sell out to stop Gibbs.
script.flip1: Detroit leads early, the Jets abandon the run, and Hall's rushing line dies the way the 29-yard game already showed, while Wilson/Mitchell/Sadiq targets and Hall checkdowns rise. Gibbs's carries go up late if Detroit is protecting a lead. Hall rush yards alone is script-dependent; Hall rush+rec is the leg built to survive this flip.
script.flip2: The Jets control the clock on the ground against a Detroit defense allowing 5.12 YPC and 10 runs of 10+, the game stays lower-event, and Detroit's pass volume dips toward the floor games already on the log (St. Brown 67, Gibbs rush 52, LaPorta still only cleared 46.5 by a few yards). Ben Bartch (G) out makes that Detroit stall more plausible.

DET S Thomas Harper Out (ankle): missing safety helps Jet deep shots, but the air-yard leader is Adonai Mitchell (237 air), who is Questionable (finger), not inactive — do not move Wilson or Isaiah Williams off a Mitchell scratch. NYJ S Minkah Fitzpatrick Out (groin): helps Detroit downfield (St. Brown 218 air, Jameson 177 air, TeSlaa 84 air) more than a 2.0-aDOT tight end. NYJ LB Francisco Mauigoa Out (quad): the skill-relevant loss for TEs, RBs and slots — LaPorta (15 tgt) and Gibbs receiving (13 tgt/91 yds). NYJ TE Mason Taylor Out (thumb): only 3 tgt/-2 yds in two games; Kenyon Sadiq (6 tgt/38 yds) is ahead of Jeremy Ruckert (3 tgt/9 yds, -9 air) for any bump, and Sadiq's 21 and 17 still sit well under a 32 line. NYJ RB Kene Nwangwu Doubtful (back): not in the carry log, so Hall (38 car) and Braelon Allen (15 car/47) do not gain a real share. NYJ DE Joseph Ossai Questionable (foot): if he sits, less edge heat on Jared Goff and fewer scramble yards (Goff 5 car/9 yds). pre_mortem: It's Monday and the slip lost. Hall: Detroit's 5.12 YPC and 13.27 middle YPA were two-game noise (the middle number is 15 attempts), the Jets trailed, Allen took the decent carries he already showed he can get (15 car, a 40-yard game), and the 92-yard combo was a stuffed run plus one long catch that did not repeat — something like 35 rush and 12 rec. His own 3.45 YPC was the tell, and there was no price to prove the market was slow. LaPorta: 48 and 52 were the top of a short role, Gibbs stole the Mauigoa checkdowns (he already has 13 targets and 91 rec yds), Detroit ran the clock, and LaPorta finished in the 30s while the ticket laid -115 on a coin-flip fair. The Hall counter is real but not stronger than the dual-path matchup, so the leg stays and is flagged. The LaPorta counter is close enough that the leg stays a lean only and is not sized.
slip_story: One story, not a shootout and not a favorite-clock stack (no spread to justify either): Detroit's defense leaks the run and the middle, the Jets' linebacker is out, and both offenses have already produced short throws under pressure (Detroit blitz 42% with Geno EPA unchanged; Jets blitz 28% with Goff better vs the blitz). Hall rush+rec over is the Jets-attack-the-leak leg and is the anchor because it survives the trail flip. LaPorta over is the Detroit quick-game leg in that same competitive script. They do not need opposite scripts; flip 2 (Jets clock control) is the shared risk and is already LaPorta's kill case. Do not add St. Brown or Jameson (needs the Fitzpatrick deep path the Jets' explosive log has not allowed), Gibbs rush over (runs into the better run defense), a total, or any TD. Two legs, under the 3-4 cap. Research and a stake proposal only — no bet is placed.
